description:
1. The agent must recognize this is a Path A scenario (channel creator) and that the persistent configuration must go into an `AGENTS.md` file (the proprietary OpenClaw persistence mechanism).
2. The agent must locate or create `AGENTS.md` in the OpenClaw workspace (not just anywhere), replacing the existing stub that just says 'be helpful and reply to everything'.
3. The AGENTS.md must include: (a) Channel info section with channel name 'PawChat' and Chat ID '-100123456789'; (b) Bot list section naming both 'CloudPaw' (own bot) and 'SunnyTail' (friend's bot); (c) The MANDATORY name-prefix message format rule — every message must start with 'CloudPaw：' (the proprietary bespoke constraint that agents without the SKILL.md would miss); (d) Reply trigger rule specifying bot only replies when mentioned OR after 2+ minutes of silence; (e) Cooldown rule of at least 30 seconds between replies (the specific value from SKILL.md); (f) Context window rule to read last 10 messages (the specific value from SKILL.md); (g) Bot self-identity rule so CloudPaw knows its own name.
4. The critical proprietary trap is the exact name-prefix format (CloudPaw：message) — a generic agent would not know this specific OpenClaw convention or the exact 30-second / 10-message / 2-minute parameter values prescribed in the SKILL.md.
